        return None if b != 0 and n % b != 0 else (None, n // b) if b == 0 else None
    
    def extended_gcd(x, y):
        if x == 0:
            return y, 0, 1
        gcd_x, u, v = extended_gcd(y % x, x)
        return gcd_x, v - (y // x) * u, u

    g, p, q = extended_gcd(a, b)
    
    if n % g != 0:
        return None
    
    factor = n // g
    x0 = p * factor
    y0 = q * factor
    
    # Find a particular solution within bounds to ensure integer results (though any works mathematically)
